description: List WWDC sessions, every year since 2014, by year, topic or text in the title or topic names: each with its title, link, topics, and whether it has a transcript and code, newest year first. Use it to browse sessions; search_wwdc_content finds what sessions said or showed, and get_wwdc_video reads one. view "years" counts each year's sessions; view "topics" lists the WWDC topics with their IDs and session counts, or one topic's sessions.

hasCode.description: sessions: true keeps the sessions with code; false, those without.

includeVideos.description: topics: false shows the topic without its sessions.

limit.description: Most sessions to show: 50 if left out, 20 of one topic's.

topic.description: sessions: a topic ID, as list_wwdc_videos with view "topics" lists them, keeps that topic's sessions; any other text keeps the sessions whose title or topic names contain it, in any case. topics: one topic's ID, to list its sessions.

view.description: "sessions": the sessions by year, topic or text in the title or topic names. "years": each WWDC year with its number of sessions, then how many sessions in all have code and a transcript. "topics": the WWDC topics with their IDs and session counts or, with topic, one topic's sessions, newest year first.

year.description: sessions, and one topic's sessions: keeps one WWDC year ("2026"); left out or "all", every year.

name: list_wwdc_videos
title: List WWDC Videos
